Sliders that never started

Two sliders on this page never started: one is still faded out waiting for its script, the other has every slide hidden. Whether a visitor meets their text is a question about the capture, so the scan says so in a note and leaves them out of the hidden share.

Stage 1: the opening time trial

Riders set off one minute apart on a flat course along the coast, and the first yellow jersey goes to the fastest of them.

Stage 2: into the hills

A rolling stage with four categorised climbs, where the sprinters' teams try to keep the breakaway within reach.

Stage 3: the long run north

The longest day of the race, flat until the final ten kilometres and a short climb to the line.
